tags.deprecated:
Use `GridItem` in a `Grid`, with `start` for `offset`. A column as wide as its
content (`span="auto"`) has no grid equivalent: use `Flex`. `@chassis-ui/css` deprecates its
flexbox grid (`.row`, `.col-*`) in 0.6 and removes it in 0.7, and `Col` goes with it.

className.description: A string of all className you want applied to the base component.
className.name: className

responsive.description: Overrides `span`/`offset`/`order` at a breakpoint and up.
responsive.name: responsive

type.name: { Partial<Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl', { span?: 'auto' | number | string | boolean, offset?: number | string, order?: 'first' | 'last' | number | string }>> }

span.description: Columns (of 12) this Col spans, or `'auto'`/`true` for a natural-width column.
span.name: span

offset.description: Columns to offset the start of this Col by.
offset.name: offset

order.description: Visual order relative to sibling columns.
order.name: order
